headline: Emirates Group Reports 66% Profit Decline Amid Regional Conflict
summary: Emirates Group reported a 66% year-over-year drop in first-half profits. The decline is attributed to high fuel costs and the ongoing regional war in the Middle East.
why: Emirates is a major global airline and a key indicator of aviation sector health in the Middle East, sensitive to both geopolitical stability and jet fuel prices.

impacts.name: Emirates Group
impacts.why: The company reported a significant decline in profitability.
